issues.originalQuote: We will preserve instances of service disruption, since removing difficult days could make the policy appear more dependable than it is.
issues.revisedQuote: We will retain instances of service disruption to ensure the policy's reliability is accurately reflected.
issues.problem: Retaining disruptions helps avoid an overly favourable assessment but cannot ensure accurate reliability estimates. The revision replaces a qualified bias concern with an unsupported guarantee.

issues.originalQuote: Sensitivity checks will vary the definition of a long wait without selecting the definition that most favours either policy.
issues.revisedQuote: Sensitivity checks will vary the definition of a long wait without favoring either policy.
issues.problem: The revision loses the explicit commitment against selecting whichever long-wait definition most favours a policy. A general statement of impartiality does not preserve this methodological safeguard.
